# Empire State Bulldogs

> AKC-registered French Bulldog breeder based in Albany, New York. Health-tested parents, rare colors, stud services, and nationwide delivery. Founded and owned by Vaughn.

Empire State Bulldogs, owned and operated by Vaughn, is a French Bulldog breeder in Albany, New York. Puppies are raised in a family home environment, health-tested, and come with a 1-year guarantee against life-threatening congenital and hereditary defects. We offer stud services, nationwide puppy delivery, and breed education.

## Available Puppies

- [Puppies](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/puppies/): Currently available French Bulldog puppies with color, gender, and health details for each pup
- [Studs](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/studs/): Our stud dogs, including King Simba. Health-tested and available for breeding inquiries

## Health, Policies & Terms

- [Health Guarantee](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/health-guarantee/): 1-year guarantee covering life-threatening congenital and hereditary defects, with full terms, coverage, exclusions, and the buyer's veterinary examination requirement
- [Breeding Policies](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/breeding-policies/): Ethical breeding standards, health testing protocols, and requirements for adopting families
- [Terms of Service](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/terms/): Terms governing site use, puppy inquiries, deposits, and stud arrangements
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/privacy/): How contact information is collected, used, and protected

## Gallery & Questions

- [Gallery](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/gallery/): Photos and videos of our puppies, parent dogs, and past litters
- [FAQ](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/faq/): Common questions about health guarantees, AKC registration, shipping, meeting the parents, and stud services

## Shipping & Service Areas

- [Shipping](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/shipping/): Nationwide delivery via flight nanny service or climate-controlled ground transport
- [Locations](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/locations/): Cities and regions we serve and deliver to
- [About](https://www.empirestatebulldogs.com/about/): Our story, breeding program, and standards

## Key Facts

- Breed: French Bulldogs, including fluffy, merle, lilac, isabella and other rare colors
- Based in Albany, New York; serving NY, NJ, CT, MA, PA and nationwide
- AKC registration on most puppies; details listed per puppy
- Health-tested parents (OFA and DNA panels)
- Family-raised and socialized from birth
- 1-year health guarantee against life-threatening congenital and hereditary defects
- Stud services available, featuring King Simba
- Nationwide delivery by flight nanny or ground transport
